This is the project integration PR for the issue-mode `/implement-plan-claude` project that fixes #4687, a security-audit follow-up (A08, high) on `scripts/review_claude_fixer_nonblocking.py:223`. It merges into the #4586 project branch (final PR #4593). Every stage before this one has now finished, so the whole project gets one more review here.

**What the project changes:** a reviewer's `REJECTED_FINDING` now binds to a pass-1 consensus entry only through a content-derived `consensus_id` (`p1-` plus 12 hex digits of SHA-256), not through file-and-line proximity. This is the project integration PR for the issue-mode `/implement-plan-claude` project that fixes #4687, a security-audit follow-up (A08, high) on `scripts/review_claude_fixer_nonblocking.py:223`. It merges into the #4586 project branch (final PR #4593). Every stage before this one has now finished, so the whole project gets one more review here.

**What the project changes:** a reviewer's `REJECTED_FINDING` now binds to a pass-1 consensus entry only through a content-derived `consensus_id` (`p1-` plus 12 hex digits of SHA-256), not through file-and-line proximity. Single-quoted text that only mentioned a backticked `` `gh api user` `` was therefore treated as a hidden call and forced a permission prompt. On 2026-09-28 a `/deploy-activate` session's `sed` edit of its activation log stopped this way.
- **Missed hidden call.** `` echo `gh api -X DELETE repos/a/b` `` with unquoted backticks got no decision from the guard at all.

**The fix.** A new `substitution_bodies()` scans the raw command the way Bash does:
- a backtick substitution outside single quotes is a hidden call when its body contains `gh api`;
- so is `$(...)` inside double quotes;
- inside a `$(...)` body, the scanner tracks the body's own quotes and backslashes, so a quoted `)` does not end it (review round 1);
- single-quoted text is data;
- an unquoted `$(...)` is unchanged, because the tokenizer already splits it into its own segments and they are classified directly.

**Backstop (review round 1).** The older token-level check still applies whenever the command holds a real (unescaped) backtick or `$(` outside single quotes and a `gh api` outside single quotes. A scanner miss therefore still asks. `has_hidden_gh_api` keeps the token reading when it is called without the command.

The `workflow-templates/` twin is identical, and the CLAUDE.md §23.H table wording is updated.

## Testing

- `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`: 178 passed.
- It has 24 new cases, all
